notes.title: Space Mutants 2 in Development!
notes.content:
Space Mutants 2 is currently in development! I have no idea when it will be complete, but things are rolling along nicely. This time around the game play experience will take a turn from being a linear playthrough to a more pf an open and explorable world. Think Metroid on the NES. Of course I will release it free of charge once it is complete. I'd rather the people play it than for it to just sit on the shelf and collect dust, lol. It will have all of the old monsters and bosses plus an additional 13 new enemy types! If you'd like to follow along with the development of this upcoming Space Mutants 2 release, here is the link to it's development page. 

https://www.nesmakers.com/index.php?threads/space-mutants-2.8935/#post-52942

[previewyoutube=wTeOhPzW6F8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Level Selection Update!
notes.content: Secret Level "Selection" Menu added. Also various fixes to gameplay. To access level selection menu: press A+B at the start screen. This will take you to the secret menu! Enjoy!

notes.title: Space Mutants Game Expansion/Update is live!!!
notes.content:
I have been working day and night on expanding, updating, and improving Space Mutants! Now everything has come to fruition and this update is live!!!!! Enjoy the new version of the game!!!!

                                                                                                    Sincerely, Tbone and Arlo P. Barnaby!

notes.title: Update on the Update!
notes.content: Things are coming along nicely with this huge expansion. New levels, New bosses, and new game functionality have been added to Space Mutants! This whole thing is going to take a little while longer to finalize. Most likely though, everything will be released before X-Mas of 2023. Then everyone can download the new version and start whoopin' some new Space Mutant arse! Well, that is it for now. I'll make another post when things are starting to get really close to a release date. Take care!

notes.title: Huge game expansion in the works!
notes.content:
I am currently working on a huge update for Space Mutants. In the works are: New levels, bosses, and enemies! This update should almost double the size of the game! There is no set time for this update to be released as of yet. I am shooting for before Christmas of 2023! I will keep everybody posted as I progress with my work. Long live Space Mutants!!!! 

                                                                                     Sincerely - Arlo P. Barnaby
